title: Integrated communication: Public discourse — civic language

frames.title: Lesson 128 · Integrated communication: Public discourse — civic language

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre a qualidade da linguagem cívica a partir de um editorial, com ritmo e ênfase de leitura em voz alta.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: Mind Your Words, Mr. Mayor
paras: Public language is a **shared resource**, and it is **wearing thin**. When officials describe their opponents as “**vermin**” or “**traitors**”, they do not merely **offend**; they **erode** the **norms** that let rivals argue **without** fear.

We **urge** the mayor to **retract** his remarks, and we **call on** all parties to **adopt** a **code of conduct** for campaign speech. Heated rhetoric is **a feature of democracy**; **dehumanising** rhetoric is **a threat to it**.
**It is not so much** civility we ask **as** accuracy. A politician who **chooses words carefully** shows **respect** for the public. **That respect**, once lost, is **hard to win back**.

items.q: It calls for a code of conduct.
It asks for accuracy rather than mere civility.
items.why: not so much civility as accuracy.

rows: We **call on** all parties to adopt…

blocks.body: Editoriais usam **verbos de exortação** + objeto + *to-infinitivo*: *urge someone to do*. O tom é de **opinião fundamentada**, não de insulto.
*Urge* + that-clause usa subjuntivo: *We urge that he retract…*

items.s: We ___ the mayor to retract his remarks. (urge)
We call ___ all parties to adopt a code. (on)
It is not so much civility ___ accuracy. (as)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Add fuel to the fire** — jogar lenha na fogueira
**Clean up one’s act** — mudar de comportamento
**We urge the mayor to retract his remarks.** — Instamos o prefeito a retratar seus comentários.
**And we call on all parties to adopt a code of conduct.** — E convocamos todos os partidos a adotar um código de conduta.
**Add that heated rhetoric is part of democracy.** — Acrescente que retórica acalorada faz parte da democracia.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

blocks.task: Write a 5-sentence editorial urging public figures to use careful language.
blocks.model: Public language is a shared resource, and it is wearing thin. We urge every candidate to choose words that inform rather than insult. We call on party leaders to adopt a code of conduct. It is not so much civility we ask as accuracy. Respect, once lost, is hard to win back.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
